balls.text: short, and dribbles away in to the leg side as he misses the pull
Nehra not getting the hat-trick, Shukla denies him with a solid defensive push down the pitch
and another one, what a flood of wickets, Menaria misses the slog, and Nehra's length ball sends middle stump cartwheeling
clears front leg, swings, and slices it high and down to third man
low full toss sent rocketing down the ground, Nadeem runs across from long off and prevents it from going for four
underedges a slog to midwicket
Warner takes it at long on and Umesh has finished with four wickets, slower ball again, good length, it was slogged well in front of Warner, but he's made ground quickly
he's gone this time, tried to lift it over extra cover, could not get too much on it, Mahela's gone back to take it safely
full, smacked straight to extra cover on the edge of the circle
slower one now, short of a length, too close to cut, Hodge beaten
pitched up on the stumps, swung down to long on
beaten by the bounce on this back of a length ball outside off, that flew through to the keeper
he's fallen after squeezing a full one to third man, but recovered to take the single
slower one, and Dravid has sent that flying over deep midwicket
can't make anything of a full toss outside off, misses, keeper collects
full one hit straight back to the bowler
has a swing and slices a full delivery over point
pitched up, chops it to point for a single
short, into the batsman, Dravid has made some room and pulled it over midwicket, wide of the man in the deep, it eventually rolls over the rope
slow and wide, Dravid waits and has a go, edge runs to the keeper
length outside off, slashed down to third man
slower ball now, Hodge beaten
quick from around back of a length, he's managed to help it behind square leg
he strikes first ball on return, length ball angled in fast, Binny backs away and swings, misses, and the stumps are uprooted
very full, slammed on the bounce to long on
neat from Binny, fine leg is up, he's used the angle off his pads to flick it over that man
huge, low full toss, and Binny has sent it soaring into the stands way beyond long on
pulls a bouncer, top edge swirls over the chasing keeper, fine leg prevents four
awkwardly turned off the pads down to fine leg
good length, swung down to extra cover
hit down to long on
swats a wide one down to long off and that is fifty for Rahul Dravid in his first innings in a long time
mistimes the pull to deep midwicket
well, Botha's gone for runs straight away, Binny comes down, he's opened the face to loft this one over long off
slog-sweep, and that will carry comfortably over the deep midwicket boundary, lunges forward on a knee, fetched it from well outside off, and connected big
backs away and swings, gets four with a thick edge to third man, he's lost his bat on that occasion, but he'll pick it up, and pocket four
misses another swipe and keeps the strike as they jog across even as the ball rolls square
backs away and cracks it down the ground, long on covers it to his left
fires it in, Dravid misses the slog, takes the leg bye to short fine
makes room to hit it down to long off
misses the big swing off the pads, takes the leg bye
down the track to force it to extra cover
now a drop as Delhi continue to bleed runs in the field, Dravid did not get hold of it as he had a go, Warner had it covered close to the long on rope, but ended up parrying it over
overthrows again, Binny opened up by a length ball on middle and leg, throw misses at striker's, and they get another run

lifted straight in the air down the ground, falls short of Warner running across from long on, now he too fumbles, but no harm done, now he hits the stumps with the throw, and they run for the ricochet
that has hurried onto him very quickly, he's surprised but manages to hook it awkwardly in the air to square leg, another fumble in the field
opens the face very late to run it fine, third man slides to stop the four
dropped, Dravid chipped a slower one in the air, Russell got a hand to it but it went down, there was a chance to run the non-striker out, but he was back in time
paddle-scoops it tamely in the air, fine leg tidies up
that slid in quick, he made room and cut it through point
moves across and inside edges it down the track
Nadeem with the breakthrough, Rahane unsure what to do with it, he's ended up forcing it back to the bowler
angled into the pads, he bends the knee and swings it down to deep square leg
worked down to wide long on
slow, shortish, angled in, Dravid immediately in position to slam it to the deep midwicket rope off the front foot
loopy slower one from round the stumps, he waits and pats it past the non-striker to long on
good length, moving across, he drives it out to sweeper cover
pitched up, he's cleared front leg and cracked it dead straight down the ground, just past the non-striker's stumps, that's disappeared instantly
forward to push smoothly to long off
hits a length ball down to long off
worked to deep midwicket
darted in quick, he's whipped that through midwicket, and the man in the deep has failed to rein it in, Nehra it is who makes a mess of a regulation stop
tries to slog-sweep this one angled in, misses
does not quite get hold of it as he tries to paddle it fine
into the pads with the angle, whipped away to deep square
that skidded on around off, he's pushed it out to the sweeper
drops it softly in front of mid off and it's an easy run in the end, DD haven't been able to stop the quick singles today
beaten by a pitched up slower one now
delicate now, allows it to come on from back of a length, and opens the face to run it fine to the third man rope
he's swatted that straight back past the bowler, the length ball hasn't bounced much, and he's powered through with the shot
opens the face to run a length ball to deep point
tries to pull, beaten as it bounces over his bat-swing
worked to deep backward square leg off the pad
comes down the track and pushes to wide long off
follows the batsman as he backs away to leg, forced out to deep midwicket
width for the cut, but he's chopped it to short cover
worked out to deep square leg
flat and shortish, he opens up to drag it to deep midwicket
pushed wide of extra cover, who runs across to cut off the single
goes for the pull, another thick edge runs down wide of fine leg
walks down, pushes softly in front of mid in and takes the single
good length, he forces it in front of square leg
this one goes across, and a thick outside edge runs to third man
length ball moving in, tries to work it away, thick inside edge down to fine leg
leans across to squeeze it just past short midwicket, mid on fields
pushed to mid off, and Dravid makes it in time
quickly bursts into a drive, but he's mistimed it to extra cover
he's placed that nicely, waited on the cut, and ensured he hit it wide of point, no chance for third man
opens the face and runs a length ball outside off down to third man
angles it full down the leg side
pulled off the front foot now, but he's hit it to forward square leg
into the pads, he turns it wide of square leg, fine leg runs around to field
comes forward and nudges a length ball, 147.5 kph, to midwicket
hurried into a pull, takes a single behind square
slower one now, Dravid is forced to adjust as he was already forward, pushes it to short extra cover, that was 142 kph apparently, now come on
quick, short of a length, he goes back and punches it to point, that was clocked at nearly 146 kph
he's gone reaching out for this pitched up delivery, a thick edge produced again, but it hasn't carried to slip
slowish across Dravid, good length, he shoulders arms
bat around front pad to turn it from the stumps to midwicket
swinging in a shade, Dravid has the forward press going neatly, and adjusts slightly to cover for the movement, and defends
that's more like it, forward to a length ball around off, and blocks
Dravid is a touch slow to get to the line of another wide one, and he's managed a thick edge that has run past the lone slip
full and wide across the right-hander, Dravid reaches out for it, misses, as does the keeper, it was dying on him and he was slow to get down

Umesh has him now, slower one, floated up outside off, speed gun will have you believe it was 137 kph, Perera done in by the change of pace, and his swing has taken the ball only as far as extra cover
147.8 kph, says the speed gun, yeah right, says Perera as he moves half forward to smash a length ball through extra cover
short, into the body, he's swivelled to pull it flat to the deep square rope
dropped, Botha got a hand out to this screamer high to his left at lone slip, but it burst out, Perera thick edged it after having a go at an outswinger going across him
short of a length, skidding through, around the pads, he swivels to help it along to fine leg
widish, good length, dabbed down to third man
full, he's picked that from well outside off stump, and turned the wrists to send it racing to the deep midwicket rope
comes forward to a pitched up ball angled across and pushes to extra cover
almost in the blockhole, dug out in front of mid and they make it across for the single
that wasn't a bad shout, but the length ball was headed down leg, as replays show
short, it's gotten big on him around off, and he's awkwardly swatted it down to mid on
into the pads, straightens, but not enough, and they take the leg bye as the ball dribbles away
guided with the away swing to backward point
tries to cut a good length outswinger, chops it into the ground
here he goes, he hasn't middled it, but this is a harmless back of a length ball, and he's clobbered it over mid on
gentle away swinger, he guides it and times it wide of point, who dives to save some runs
lovely, it arrives full and wide outside off, Ojha cannot reach that, and Rajasthan have completed an unbelievable comeback
Cooper has taken off on a run, this game has turned on its head, Russell has gone across to attempt a paddle, missed, like Botha had, and the ball has crashed into the stumps
Cooper keeps hitting the blockhole, what an over this is, Irfan get some bat on it down the leg side, keeper tidies up
he's gone for the reverse paddle, missed, and is struck right in front of off, this is not over yet
hits the blockhole as Russell makes room outside leg, deep midwicket keeps them to one with a quick release
full and on middle, hit down to long on
shortish and wide, cut straight to the sweeper for one
another full toss, smashed down the ground, Cooper cuts off the boundary at long off
high full toss, he's swung that to short fine leg, who's unable to stop it, and two more knocked off
direct hit, will that change this game, stand-in captain Hodge gives his side some breathing space with a pick up and throw from extra cover, Warner had no chance to complete the single
another low full toss, thick inside edged to fine leg
full and quick down the leg side at 138.6 kph
a full toss on the pads, deep square leg slides to save the four, but his throw is weak enough to concede the second
dropped short, and he swats it in the air for deep midwicket to take a tumbling catch
hits the pad and rolls fine down leg as Warner misses
almost in the blockhole, Warner gets legs out of the way to stab it through midwicket, they take on the throw for the second, and Juneja's dive saves him
whips a full one to deep midwicket
tries to swing it from outside off over midwicket and misses
flayed straight down the ground to long off
worked in front of square leg to keep the strike
it's taken him 51 deliveries, but here's Warner's first six, fetches it from leg stump and murders it way over deep midwicket
slightly short and pulled instantly to deep square
walks down the pitch and misses a heave to a slower one
slow and on the pads, swung down to deep square
spots some width and lashes a cut to the deep backward point rope, Warner stepping it up now
driven crisply down to long off
yet another couple to Warner with a nudge to the leg side, who needs boundaries
full and wide, hit to sweeper cover
fuller and squeezed out to point
slow long hop, and it's been carted several rows into the stands at deep midwicket
they have kept denying him width and he's kept picking up runs through midwicket, happens again
fuller, dabbed to point
short once more, worked to deep midwicket
dropped now, Warner's pulled with more power this time, substitute Chavan puts it down at deep square leg
reverts to short and quick, and Warner ensures it goes for runs with a pull to the deep square leg rope
nice, tossed up slowly across Warner, who pushes forward and is beaten
short and flat, whipped to deep midwicket
slow and full, two more to Warner as he turns it to deep midwicket
width, and Warner capitalises, placing the cut wide of the sweeper, and that is also his fifty
worked to midwicket for one
walks across to a very wide one and misses the cut
eased straight down the ground for a single to long off
rapped on the pads, but the appeal is turned down, probably headed down leg, was bowled from wide of the crease
sends it down the leg side now
slow length ball on the pads, worked through square leg
good length, guided wide of point for one
full, wide, and Warner has got enough on it to run it to the third man rope
reaches out to a wide one and underedges it to the keeper
Warner hurried into a pull, and a top edge flies one bounce over the boundary behind the keeper
he's tried to work it to leg, but ended up chipping it high in the air, on the bounce to long on
back of a length, hops in the air and chops a cut to point
dabs a slower one to third man
Waner's been doing this all the time today, worked to deep midwicket
that surprised Warner, seemed to stop on him, as he stabbed it to mid off
opens the face and picks up one to third man
shuffles and works it off middle to the fine leg boundary
worked through square leg off the pads

Ajinkya Rahane has pulled off a stunner at point, Mahela's got a leading edge to a full delivery, and Rahane has gone flying to his right to pluck it from the air, big strike for Shukla in his first over
pushes to extra cover who can't stop the ball and concedes the single
angled too far across the left-hander once again
full one turned to mid on, throw misses, Mahela makes it
pitched up just outside off at 132 kph, pushed to extra cover
to fine leg for a single
sprays it way outside off stump now
Shukla is taken for four first ball, pitched up on the stumps, Warner flicks it over midwicket
off the pads to the leg side
turned off the pads to deep square
steered wide of third man, Binny runs across and slides to keep them to two
driven to mid off for a single
two this time, to Warner, to midwicket again
they've been kept to one this time, after another nudge by Mahela to midwicket, man runs in from the deep and lets rip with the throw, Warner abandons the idea of the second
walks out and works it to deep midwicket
nice, slow, shortish, and wide, all Mahela has done it steer it wide of short third man, and he's collected four
a push from Warner pops up in the air down to long off
overthrows, four of them, from Rahane, Mahela dropped this towards backward point and took off, Rahane missed with the throw, and it raced wide of mid on
Sreesanth has bowled a lovely little spell on IPL comeback, Warner's pushed this pitched up delivery to long on
around the blockhole, Warner pushes it to mid off
Mahela chips down the pitch and swings one down to deep midwicket, didn't time it
across to push it down the pitch
opens the face to guide a length ball to the sweeper
full toss outside off, and Warner cracks it between extra cover and mid off
just outside off, nudged through vacant midwicket, and by the time long on runs in, they have taken two
turned in front of square leg, Warner not getting the space to swing
Warner's worked it off the pads through midwicket, it's beaten deep midwicket's dive too, but long on has covered up well, Warner charges back for two and dives in
Mahela gets width and sends this one to third man
on the pads now, worked through midwicket
starts on a good length, on off, Warner defends
bat around pad to push down to mid on
runs a pitched up ball to point softly
Chand's been bowled again, Sreesanth celebrates, Chand caught on the crease to one that nips in from a length, has his stumps uprooted
slower length ball, thick inside edge on to pad and they are through for the single quickly
hit on the pad off a length ball, Sreesanth bends his knees for the big appeal, but that was headed down leg
lucky for Chand, on the move down the track, throws his bat at it, and the ball flies over the lone slip
this length is not working for Badree, short and flat again, and Warner has pulled it hard to the deep midwicket rope
overpitched, and he's drilled it straight past the bowler
slapped straight to cover on the edge of the circle
tosses it up, Chand hesitant to come forward, nudges it to leg
similar delivery, pulled down to long on
quick and flat on middle, he makes room and pushes to extra cover
superb over, length ball straightening just outside off, Chand plays it from the crease and runs it to point
dropped, Dravid puts it own at backward point, it was finer than the normal position, Warner slashed it high towards Dravid, who leaped, got both hands to it, but it flew through
fullish again, Warner reaches forward and times the drive, but straight to mid off
tight line from Sreesanth, just around off, pitched up, pushed to extra cover
squeezed for room with one that comes in from back of a length
checks the push to extra cover off a pitched up ball on off
moves forward to push it through midwicket, Warner quick enough to come back for the second
misses the slog sweep to a full one now
short and hurrying on, Chand pulls it over square leg, hasn't timed it too well
skiddy one punched to deep midwicket
worked square off the pad
he's connected this one alright, slog sweep to a full one on middle, just out of the reach of deep midwicket
Warner falls over after being hit on the pad with one swinging in, hit outside leg stump though
another slog, it runs off a thick inside edge to deep backward square
pushed to point
that has raced away four, Chand steps out and swings hard, gets it through vacant midwicket, mid on chases, but the outfield it too fast
lovely, drew him forward, got it to move away from a length, and beat the edge
theatrical on the knee appeal first up from Sreesanth, hits him high on the pad with one that nips in from back of a length, headed down leg
almost played on, this one was tossed up, Chand went for the drive, thick inside edge scurried past the stumps
quick and skidding on, rolls to short fine leg off the pad
slogged to deep midwicket
misses as he tries to sweep, the ball goes down leg
beaten outside off stump as it skids on quickly
Chand almost gets another first-ball dismissal, appeal for lbw turned down, hit with a full one on leg stump
skidding across the left-hander first up, worked through midwicket, Cooper keeps them to one
